notes: PAP reference G35/3308. Whole three-room apartment with 102.58 m2 floor area and 93.40 m2 Carrez on the first floor of a secured 1986 coproperty near Reims' Barbatre and Saint-Remi districts. The complete advert describes a south-facing living room opening to a large balcony, independent fitted kitchen, two large bedrooms with dressing storage, bathroom with shower and bath, separate WC, second balcony and shared maintained garden. A possible future additional room is only an optional renovation. It states individual gas heating, DPE C, monthly charges of EUR 323 including the works reserve and property tax of EUR 1,650. The live text contains no tenant, lease or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 18 September 2026.
